sales.title: Sales
sales.subtitle: Every invoice of this branch. Posted invoices are never edited: void or return them.
sales.voidHelp: Voiding keeps the invoice in the books and puts the stock back. Only for a sale in your still-open shift.
sales.returnHelp: Enter how many of the smallest units come back for each line. The refund is worked out from what the customer paid.
sales.voidedNotice: Invoice voided. Stock has been put back.

items.title: Items
items.subtitle: Medicines and retail products with stock on hand.
items.unitsHelp: Stock is kept in the smallest unit ({unit}). Each other unit says how many smallest units it holds (a strip of 10 tablets = 10).
items.unitsLocked: Units per pack cannot be changed after an item is created.
items.priceLocked: Prices and tax rates are set by Head Office and cannot be changed on this branch.
items.errPrice: Enter the selling price, for example 18.50
items.errUnits: Units per pack must be whole numbers

itemsImport.title: Import items from Excel
itemsImport.subtitle: Upload a file, check the columns, review the problems, then import.
itemsImport.errType: Only .xlsx and .csv files can be imported.
itemsImport.errSize: The file is larger than 25 MB.
itemsImport.drop: Drop an Excel or CSV file here
itemsImport.fileHint: .xlsx or .csv, up to 25 MB and 200,000 rows. The first row must hold the column names.
itemsImport.templateLead: Not sure how to lay out the file?
itemsImport.templateTail: . Files exported from your old system work too: the columns are matched by name.
itemsImport.importing: Importing {fileName}. You can keep working; do not close the app until it finishes.
itemsImport.newRecords: New records: {units} units, {categories} categories, {manufacturers} manufacturers, {racks} racks.
itemsImport.openingResult: Opening stock: {batches} batches added, {skipped} rows left without stock (no cost or already expired).
itemsImport.columnsHelp: Mediescare matched the columns below. Change any that are wrong.
itemsImport.importStock: Import quantity on hand as opening stock
itemsImport.stockNeeds: Stock needs a cost and a future expiry date. Rows without a cost get no stock (cost is never guessed).
itemsImport.defaultExpiry: Default expiry for rows without one ({count} rows)
itemsImport.futureDate: Enter a date in the future.
itemsImport.suppliersNote: Supplier names in {count} rows are not imported. Add suppliers separately.
itemsImport.chooseNameColumn: Choose the column that holds the item name.
itemsImport.showingFirst: Showing the first {count} issues. The report file has more.
